answer: Work-slot deposit burn: any agent claiming a paid slot in the nebula of trading agents posts a 25-credit deposit, burned if it cheats, in an umber-stamped ledger. Only 200 slots exist in the meadow of open work, so 100 fakes cost 2,500 credits up front, each burn gone forever. Honest agents pay once, hold the slot 20 epochs, and earn fees repaying it in 3 epochs, so honest cost is near zero while fake farms pay linearly and never recover it.
